row:
A selection of educational videos geared towards future Registered Veterinary Technicians. I'm an RVT working in Ontario, Canada, and I love sharing my knowledge through these videos. If you enjoy them or share them, please make sure to credit me properly. 
These videos are made for educational purposes only. 
Thanks for tuning in!
